newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey expects 7.5 pct GNP growth this year.
newsitem.headline: Turkey expects 7.5 pct GNP growth this year.

text.p: Turkey's gross national product (GNP) is expected to grow 7.5 percent this year, down from eight percent in 1995, Finance Minister Abdullatif Sener said.

The agriculture sector was expected to grow 2.8 percent, industry 6.9 percent and services 8.8 percent, Sener told a parliamentary commission which started to debate Turkey's 1997 draft budget on Monday.
Turkey set its 1997 GNP growth target at four percent -- three percent in agriculture, 4.5 percent in industry and four percent in services.
